profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Kargo
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience specializing in JavaScript, ad tech (IMA SDK, Google Ad Manager, Prebid), and video technology. Skilled in building scalable video and ad solutions for web platforms, with a focus on performance and user experience.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Troubleshot a wide range of customer issues and debugged
custom implementations through emails/screenshares
• Created code demos for customers to showcase the
customization possibilities of our products
• Collaborated with product managers and software engineers
to escalate customer issues and feature requests
• Programmed apps/extensions to help improve the

• Led the on-boarding of new support engineers by curating
documentation and coaching
• Monitored the support queue to adhere to the support team's
quarterly SLA goals

projects.title: Code Bono
projects.description:
A platform for non-profit organizations to post proposals and developers to collaborate on them. Developers are given a collaboration page for each of their projects with text/video chat and a Github project board for convenience and to facilitate their meetings.

Technologies Used: Javascript, React, Semantic UI, React-Redux, PostgreSQL, Sequelize, Node, Express, WebRTC API, Socket.io, Github API.

projects.title: Graceshopper
projects.description:
Graceshopper was an e-commerce website created for a group project. The front-end was developed with React.js, React-Redux, and Semantic UI for styling. The back-end was handled with Express.js, Seqeulize and PostgreSQL as our database management system. 

Roles: Added Stripe API to our project to handle real time card  payments. Worked with the past orders page and database models to update and show order details. Assisted in making the all products and single product views and front-end/back-end routing.

organizations.name: Stony Brook Leadership and Creativity Lab
organizations.description:
•	Ran various lab experiments and tested different conditions and recorded the results
•	Worked with team members to efficiently and effectively run and design lab experiments
•	Reported findings during weekly meetings to discuss and improve on current and new upcoming lab experiments
•	Developed the script and ran initial pilot sessions for the Accounting Error Study Lab Experiment
•	Represented the lab’s name by participating in many community service and campus life activities
